name: new_bank_v2_force_personal_calibration
unsupported_condition: MVC has only two native repetitions per class, so a matched 0/1/2-shot comparison with held-out repetitions is impossible
primary_arm: F0v2 selected by the parent validation split
secondary_arm: F0v2+F2a is a fixed diagnostic control; its parent final-only advantage cannot select it
source_fit: source-only feature state, trial StandardScaler and balanced LogisticRegression C=1; no target refit
prototype_temperature: median source-trial mean-squared distance to source-class centroid, minimum 1e-6
fusion: for nonzero shots, fixed 0.5 source probability plus 0.5 softmax negative target-prototype mean-squared distance divided by source-only temperature
selection: no choice of arm, shots or fusion weight using validation or final outcomes; matched-budget descriptive comparison
endpoint: pooled and subject/condition macro-F1, log loss, Brier, worst-condition F1 and paired corrected/new errors
boundary: public eight-channel 1000 Hz instructed intensity; target calibration and evaluation native trials disjoint; no own-device or live claim
